Package ep.service

Class ScheduleManager

java.lang.Object
ep.service.ScheduleManager
public class ScheduleManager extends Object
The planner. Given an assignment and a number of hours it cuts the hours into blocks of the preferred length and searches backward from the deadline for free slots.

Placement rules (plain enough to be checked on the calendar):

  • Blocks go on days strictly before the due date and never in the past.
  • Within a day, candidate slots lie between DAY_START and DAY_END and are tried from the latest to the earliest in STEP_MINUTES steps.
  • A slot is free when it touches no fixed event and no other study block. An all-day event blocks its whole day.
  • The planner first places at most one block per day (starting at the day before the deadline), then makes further passes to add a second, third, ... block per day while hours remain and a slot can still be found.
  • If hours remain after that, they are reported as unscheduled.

    • plan

      public PlanResult plan(Assignment assignment, int hours)
      Plans hours of work for an assignment. Existing blocks of the same assignment are treated as busy time, so callers normally remove them first (see AssignmentManager.replan(Assignment)). The returned blocks are not added to the store.
      Parameters:
      assignment - the assignment (gives deadline, block length, title)
      hours - number of hours to place
      Returns:
      placed blocks and the number of hours that did not fit
